title: Silica-supported Pt(0) single-atom catalyst chemisorbing hydrogen but converting to Pt(IV) by ambient oxygen
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11557-11561
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00018E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Gwang-Jin Na, Jongha Hwang, Ryong Ryoo
Pt(0) single atoms on porous silica show strong hydrogen chemisorption (2.0H/Pt) but no olefin hydrogenation activity, and are readily oxidized to Pt(IV) upon exposure to oxygen.
